player_prompt.intro:
Nang Connect Four na Player {player_id} rai.
Nang disc symbol: {symbol}.
Game board na {num_rows} shang na {num_cols} kaw rai.
Player ni gawng shang shaloi kaw kasha (0 to {end_col}) na disc lut sai.
Masha na mungdan (kasha) masum kawng shaloi, kachyi kawng shaloi, kaja kawng shaloi na four disc lut sai rai.
Nang shaloi, kaw kasha ma na squared brackets lut sai.
Chyeju: '[col 4]' kaw '[col 1]' rai.

board.board_notvisible_state: Dai ginsup ai lam hpe, dai sumpan hta lawm ai ni n mu lu na re.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Hkang gaw format na re. Format shadau: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Hkang gaw na. Column {col} shadau na re.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Hkang gaw na. Column {col} shan htung ga re.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} disk ({player_symbol}) column {col} shang ah hkan sa wa na.

outcome.win: {player_id} gaw 4 hpe matut mahkai nna dang ai.
outcome.draw: Dai ginsup ai lam gaw dang hkra sha ngut wa sai.
